notes.title: 1.09 Update is Live
notes.notes:
Small bugfix update.

-Fixed issue where cubes could sometimes move on the first turn after they split
-Potential fix for multiple player units spawning on same space
-Potential fix for enemy forces going first sometimes

Let me know if you encounter any new bugs or these old ones crop up again!

notes.title: 1.08 Update is Live...and New Greenlight Announcement!
notes.notes:
Please vote for our new Greenlight project Axes and Acres! Every vote really helps and is hugely appreciated! Link here:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=604936793

***

1.08 Changelog:

-Added stats tracking! (Stats are in the Bonus menu!)
-Added 4x4 visual grid divider option (accessible during a match in the lower right)
-Added "X" icon to wizards when the paladin is selected to show that they cannot be refreshed
-Tweaked several prisoner's notes
-Reroll is only active in practice mode if the initial configuration conntains an offensive unit

As always, which of the following features would you most like to see implemented in a future big update? Comment below! 

1) Particular stats
2) Linux version
3) Keyboard support
4) Somthing else!

Please email braingoodgames (at) gmail (dot) com

notes.title: 1.07 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
***FUTURE UPDATE POLL BELOW*** 

-Added TIME ATTACK mode! (accessible from the Bonus menu)
-Implemented separate sound/music volume controls
-Changed Endless Mode to ramp in ranks like a placement match
-Reworked Placement Match/Endless turns remaining mechanics
-Fixed bug with end of turn code not firing in certain circumstances
-Re-scaled very high ranks
-Tweaked Menu UI

As always, which of the following features would you most like to see implemented in a future big update? Comment below! 

1) Steam Cloud saves 
2) Stats for floors cleared, enemies killed, etc 
3) Linux version 
4) Keyboard support
5) Something else! (let me know in the comments) 

Please email braingoodgames (at) gmail.com with bugs and feedback!

-Increased font smoothness (!!)
-Fixed bug with practice mode setting rank

-Rescaled very high rank Dark World spawn values
-Fixed Desolation achievement
